data.body: CI root-caused: origin/main advanced 7 commits incl. c433663 '980d Git 2.38+ floor' which added .github/git-version-floor.txt + a Verified-gate step that reads it. My stack predated it, so the gate failed 'missing .github/git-version-floor.txt' on every patchset (NOT the earlier mirror-fetch race). Fix: rebased whole 5-change stack (df3a,0fa4,531b,a40f,2fd6) onto origin/main (clean, Change-Ids preserved, floor file inherited), re-validated (104 tests + lint + typecheck green), re-pushed all 5 (new patchsets 1408/1410/1411/1412/1414). Awaiting fresh CI.
